mapper.select: SELECT * FROM submission WHERE status = 1 AND judging_lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND judging_lease_expires_at < NOW() AND is_delete = 0 ORDER BY judging_lease_expires_at LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT * FROM submission WHERE (status = 0 OR (status = 1 AND judging_lease_expires_at IS NULL)) AND update_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{idleSeconds} SECOND) AND is_delete = 0 ORDER BY update_time LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT user_id AS userId, COUNT(*) AS submitCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN verdict = 'ACCEPTED' THEN question_id END) AS acceptedCount FROM submission WHERE is_delete = 0 AND user_id IN #{uid} GROUP BY user_id

SELECT question_id AS questionId, COUNT(*) AS submitCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN verdict = 'ACCEPTED' THEN 1 END) AS acceptedCount FROM submission WHERE is_delete = 0 AND question_id IN #{qid} GROUP BY question_id
